source_name: Pakistan Stock Exchange — Data Portal (symbols + company pages)
notes: Official PSX data portal. https://dps.psx.com.pk/symbols returns an OPEN JSON array of all listed symbols (verified: 1,068 symbols; 744 non-debt/non-ETF equities) with symbol, name, sectorName, isETF, isDebt. Per-company pages at dps.psx.com.pk/company/{symbol} return browser-public HTML with sector, registered address, free float, shares. Listed companies only. No auth/payment. License/reuse terms not stated (confirm).

organization: Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP)
notes: Authoritative Pakistani company/LLP registrar. The SECP website returned HTTP 403 (WAF) and eServices.secp.gov.pk TIMED OUT (firewalled from this environment). Company name search and the eServices portal are the access path; full filings require login. Key = CUIN (Company Universal Identification Number) / SECP registration number. Directors are personal data. Field model from public knowledge; nothing captured (not reachable here).

source_name: FBR — Active Taxpayers List (ATL) / NTN verification
notes: FBR publishes the Active Taxpayers List (ATL) of income-tax filers. The ATL pages are public but provide per-NTN ONLINE VERIFICATION (and the Tax Asaan app / SMS); a clean open BULK ATL download file was NOT located here (the category pages are informational, no direct .zip/.txt). Identifier = NTN (National Tax Number). Covers companies and individuals (individuals are personal data). Confirm whether a bulk ATL file is openly available.
Reachable third-party open-data portal. Not an official government registry and no authoritative company-register dataset confirmed. Listed for completeness; not used as a company source.
